## About Try Ace Private Limited

Data last updated: 11 February 2026

Try Ace Private Limited is a private limited company based in Thane, Maharashtra, India. It specialises in accounting and financial advisory, a part of the broader professional services sector. Incorporated on 02 April 2019, the company has been in operation for over 7 years.

Registered with ROC Mumbai under CIN U74110MH2019PTC323527.

Capital: an authorised share capital of ₹10 Lakh and a paid-up capital of ₹1 Lakh. Formerly known as Amv Entertainments Private Limited. It is led by directors Dinker Kailashnath Pathak and Prakash Doddanna Shetty.

Last AGM: 30 November 2021. Financial statements filed for year ended 31 March 2021. Office: Thane, Maharashtra.
